sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined for the Commercial Payment Policy will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCD's) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCD's) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements .

1. The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE for diagnosing a nutritional disorder or as part of a general wellness exam. Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans The payment criteria for 82180, 82379, 82607, 82746, 84207, 84252, 84425, 84446, 84590 and 84597 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Novitas Solutions, Inc. The payment criteria for 82495, 82525, 83785, 84255, and 84630 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to National Government Services, Inc. The payment criteria for 82652 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to National Government Services, Inc.; Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC; Novitas Solutions, Inc.; Palmetto GBA and WPS Insurance Corporation. The payment criteria for 83735 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC and Palmetto GBA.
